audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0] call Diana an AD assassin. Every ability in her kit deals magic damage.
audit.why: Crescent Strike, Pale Cascade, Lunar Rush and Moonfall are all magic damage, and Moonsilver Blade's cleave is magic too. Kassadin's passive reduces magic damage and Null Sphere shields magic damage, so the shield is fully live in this matchup — the opposite of what the page said.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0] rewritten around the magic-damage interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Diana rows 4 and 5 and 'Skill' at row 6, while content gave Kassadin rows 4-6.
audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely even and both the content whys and spikes[1] already say so — Moonfall (100s at rank 1) answers Riftwalk and vice versa. First item and beyond are Kassadin's: Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1 unless she has a Moonlight mark, and her burst is the damage type he resists.
audit.corrected: Row 4 set to Skill on both layers; rows 5 and 6 set to Kassadin on the full layer to match content.

audit.why: Spikes place her at 3-5, the coinflip at 6, and Kassadin at first item and full build — consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and did not state the Lunar Rush reset condition properly.
audit.why: Lunar Rush has NO cooldown when used on a Moonlight-afflicted target; otherwise it is 22/20/18/16/14s. Dodging Crescent Strike (8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) is therefore what keeps her dash on cooldown.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with the real numbers and the reset condition.
